The petitioners apprehend arrest in connection with Supaul P.S. Case No. 978 of 2022 dated 22.10.2022 instituted for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. The allegation against the petitioners are that they got appointed on the post of Special Survey Amin on the basis of forged and fabricated documents.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are innocent and they have been falsely implicated in this case.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners were appointed on the post of Special Survey Amin and were terminated from the same without giving any notice.

Learned counsel for the petitioner further submits that after due verification of the institution which was affiliated, the petitioners have got admission in the said institution and successfully passed in the examination and got valid certificate.

It is further submitted that due to negligence on the part of the authority without properly verifying the certificate of the petitioners,
the First Information Report has been lodged.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that at the time of appointment, all the relevant documents were verified by the authority but thereafter without giving any opportunity to the petitioners, the present F.I.R. has been lodged.

Learned counsel for the petitioners further submits that similarly situated co-accused have been granted anticipatory bail vide order dated 20.07.2023 passed in Criminal Miscellaneous No. 26670 of 2023 and order dated 24.03.2023 passed in Criminal Miscellaneous No. 2426 of 2023, by different co-ordinate Bench of this Court.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that some of the accused persons have also granted anticipatory bail by a co-ordinate Bench of this Court, whose details are mentioned in Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.50895 of 2023(2) dt.19-08-2023 annexure-3 and 4.
Lastly, it has been submitted that petitioners have no criminal antecedent against them.
5. Learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioners.

6. Having considered the facts and circumstances of the case and submissions of learned counsel for the parties, in the event of arrest / surrender of the petitioners within a period of six weeks from today, in connection with Supaul P.S. Case No. 978 of 2022 they shall be released on anticipatory bail upon furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 10,000/- (ten thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Supaul subject to condition as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.
(Khatim Reza, J) premchand/-
